sections.heading: Classes & Levels
sections.body: The Design tallies what you do; it writes classes and levels while you sleep — keep doing what you want to become.

sections.heading: Skills & the Hotbar
sections.body: Skills never trigger themselves. The field bar opens with names and effects; use its Details control to show or hide that readout.

sections.heading: The Boards
sections.body: The Request Board and the Runner's Guild board post bounties and deliveries — accept first, then only what you do after counts. The Notice Wall posts rumors and notices — leads turn up on every board.

sections.heading: Sleep
sections.body: Sleep is when it lands — classes, level-ups, and evolutions resolve overnight. The boards can turn over, and the day begins again.

sections.heading: Saving
sections.body: Save and Load live in the pause menu — three manual slots, plus an autosave after fights, level-ups, and doors.

sections.heading: Controls
sections.body: For the full key, pad, and mouse layout, see Controls... on this same menu.
